print.name: X1C/P1P style nozzle wiper MOD for Voron [Beta]
print.description:
Motivation

The X1C printer has a good and well-working nozzle wiper that is easy to source. I want to implement a similar system for Voron Trident and 2.4 using the Bambu lab wiper accessory.

The Bambu lab wiper accessory is a simple and effective way to clean nozzles. It is made of a durable material and can be easily mounted to the printer. I believe that this system would be a valuable addition to the Voron Trident and 2.4, as it would help to keep the nozzles clean and Z offsets spot on.

Here are some of the benefits of using the Bambu lab wiper accessory for Voron Trident and 2.4:

  • Easy to source: The wipers are readily available on Bambu lab stores in EU, US, INT.

  • Simple to install: The wiper is easy to mount to the printer and requires no permanent modifications.

  • Effective: The wipers are made of a durable material and can effectively clean nozzle without risking damaging the nozzle or silicone sock.

  • Affordable: The wipers are relatively inexpensive, making them a cost-effective way to improve your printer.

How it works


Feedback

This is a BETA mod, any feedback and PR will be much appreciated.
PM me in Printables or @iconicfab at Discord.

STEP file will be released as soon as testing will be completed.

Things to look at:

  • General fit

  • How easy/painful is printing

  • Height of the wiper vs its mounting position

BOM

  • 1 x Nozzle Wiper accessory by Bambu lab

  • 1 x M3x (16-20mm) SHCS bolt * 1 - attaching to the frame

  • 1 x M3 x (6-8mm) SHCS bolt * 1 - attaching wiper to printed part

  • 1 x M3 (4 x 5 mm) heat-set insert ("Voron standard")

  • 1 x HFSB5-2020-232-LTP spring ball nut (preferably) or T-Nut

Print instructions

  • ASA or ABS | PETG for non-enclosed only, not recommended as the part is close to the heated bed.

  • Layer height: 0.2mm

  • Extrusion width: 0.4mm, forced

  • Infill percentage: > = 40%

  • Infill type: grid, gyroid, honeycomb, triangle, or cubic

  • Wall count: 4

  • Solid top/bottom layers: 5

  • Supports: None

As seen on Discord:

Nice! Stealing this. Time to toss the ol brass brush.
[ The Ol Bamboozler V2.2587 ]

Change log

  • 26.07.2026 — STEP file added.

  • 20.08.2023 - Beta 1.2. Added support for wiper ears, no need to cut them off anymore. Added M3 (4 x 5mm) heat-set insert providing a more stable mounting of the Wiper. Updated BOM.
     

  • 06.08.2023 - Beta 1.1. The screw hole for fixing the wiper is changed to ø 2.8, the recommendation is to use SCHS/BCHS self-tapping M3 bolt to secure it. Standard (Bambu lab) bolt will not provide satisfactory results. Few other minor model tweaks. Material recommendations added. In-action video from tests added.
     

  • 05.08.2023 - Initial version.
     

Attribution

The wiper mount base is derivative from Voron2.4 SexBolt ZEndstop by hartk1213
